about: Notes on the NAP's own price for some chargers, outside MOBI.E, where ohmigo shows the NAP's pricePerDeliveryUnit as the operator's price. A plain note says that price is wrong: it's left out and the note's why goes into the assumptions. "vatIncluded": true says it's right but published with VAT in (every other NAP price comes without): it's kept and no VAT is added. "timeOfUse": true says the operator's price changes with the time of day and the NAP carries only one value. "walkUp": true says the same price is charged by bank card at the charger's terminal, so the option says app or card. Scope by NAP operator id (operatorIds) or site id (siteIds). Every note needs why, source and checkedAt. Guide: docs/04-operator-offers.md.

notes.why: The NAP carries Tesla's app price without a subscription, VAT in, at its peak band. Checked in the Tesla app on 29 Oct 2026 at five sites, NAP = app peak each time: Mealhada 0.58 (0.41/0.27 off-peak), Castelo Branco 0.60 (0.33), Fátima 0.69 (0.30), Matosinhos 0.79 (0.71/0.31), Loulé 0.83 (0.72/0.39); congestion fees up to 0.50 €/min. Paying by bank card at the terminal (TPA) costs the same as the app, per a user who charges there. Without this note ohmigo added 23 % VAT on top.
